categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: urban domestic waste incineration power generation, energy-saving and environmental protection equipment manufacturing, and electrical equipment manufacturing. It also engages in synergistic disposal of multiple solid wastes, including kitchen waste, sludge, and dead animals, and provides comprehensive environmental protection services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced grate furnace incineration technology for waste treatment, AI-based combustion optimization control systems, and low-nitrogen combustion technologies to reduce emissions. It develops modular and intelligent environmental protection equipment, including water treatment and solid waste treatment devices, and manufactures specialized electrical equipment such as transformer core shearing and coil winding machines. The company emphasizes digitalization, intelligent upgrades, and green technology innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local governments, state-owned power grid companies, industrial parks, and large groups requiring waste treatment and environmental solutions. The company serves urban waste management, industrial wastewater treatment, and electrical equipment sectors, with significant sales to provincial power companies and municipal environmental agencies.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span across 16 provinces in China, including major regions such as East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast. The company also exports products to over 50 countries including Italy, Russia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Turkey, India, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection industry, focusing on waste treatment services, equipment manufacturing, and power generation. It also manages upstream supply through strategic resource acquisition and project management, including entrusted management of subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI and digital technologies for intelligent waste incineration control, developing small-scale incineration equipment, enhancing resource recycling and high-value utilization of waste byproducts, and expanding overseas markets under the Belt and Road initiative. The company invests in R&D for low-nitrogen combustion, modular equipment, and integrated environmental solutions, aiming to lead in green, low-carbon, and smart environmental technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through waste treatment service fees, electricity sales from waste-to-energy projects, equipment sales, and construction service contracts under BOT, BOO, and BT models. The company also earns income from entrusted management fees and government subsidies related to environmental projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading central enterprise in China's environmental protection sector with strong brand recognition and extensive project portfolio. It competes with other large state-owned and private environmental service providers and equipment manufacturers, leveraging its technological innovation, operational expertise, and government partnerships to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 5.92 billion RMB, a slight decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 605 million RMB. Total assets stood at over 30.5 billion RMB with a net asset value of 13.5 billion RMB. The company has experienced steady growth with ongoing investments in technology and market expansion, despite some fluctuations in profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its central enterprise platform advantages, mature operational experience, and comprehensive service system integrating waste incineration, synergistic waste disposal, and equipment manufacturing. Its unique value lies in advanced technology adoption, including AI-driven combustion control, modular and intelligent equipment design, and strong government and industry collaborations, enabling high-efficiency, low-emission waste treatment and resource recycling solutions.
